objective: Test one fixed topology-based composition of two previously frozen models on fresh games. Shared-model studies showed complementary domain results; prior scores are selection evidence only, never a combined match score.
routing: plane7/9/11 always use plane model; sphere3/4/5 and torus7/9/11 always use curves model. No state-, opponent-, score- or result-dependent selection. No changes to either checkpoint. No alternative combinations after new outcomes.

runtime.modelSwitch: Cancel and wait for active search before disposing it and initializing the next model. Preserve64 visits, FPU1,legal/proof/pass behaviour and cancellation.
runtime.discovery: Optional modelRoutes in the ordinary v3 manifest; standard single-model manifests retain existing behaviour.
runtime.integrity: Pin expected child-model SHA in the route descriptor; same-origin subdirectory routes only; validate ONNX/FP32 checksums.
runtime.deployment: No production model replacement before all gates. Runtime routing is inert for the existing manifest. No hosted deployment or push.

data.previousScores: Do not sum the old plane and curve scores as evidence. Use only newly registered games for adoption.

matches.seed: FNV1a32(phaseSeed|board|pair|ply); shared legal opening and per-ply seed across colour-swapped pair
matches.caps: Retain and area-score actual Game state; no outcome-dependent replacements.

correctness: Routing by kind only and exact child hash
Never more than1 initialized active player; cancel/initialization/switch/disposal races
Legacy single-model regression and default64 visits
Actual CPU/WebGPU routed-vs-direct equivalence on all9 boards
Actual application Worker initializes and switches models without v2 fallback
Replay every game, actor, seed,source child hash, root visit count and score

coldAndSwitch.record: Initialize/default curve model then first plane turn; separately record curve->plane->curve switching and total model asset bytes.

latency.fixtures: 27 ordinary roots from first candidate development pair0/colour1 at N/4,N/2,3N/4, clamped to final nonterminal saved ply;3 predefined public stress roots. Freeze concrete files before timing.
latency.condition: No match/training jobs during timing; alternating sides; real WASM CPU and WebGPU Workers.
latency.equalTime: Baseline-only calibration on frozen roots establishes per-board budgets before candidate fixed-time root comparisons. Diagnostic only; fixed-time playing-strength matches are not part of this round.
latency.mobile: No phone performance claim without real phone measurement.

stopping: Failure closes this routing round. Do not substitute another plane/curve model or add more games after independent failure. Archive all evidence. Local integration only if every correctness, strength, ordinary/stress/cold timing gate passes; no push/hosted deployment.
